name: Arc Side Gaiden 1: Fukou no Tabibito...?
original_name: アークサイド 外伝１【不幸の旅人…？】
source:
An incident happens at a village where a party of one mage and three swordsmen comes. It's not about great demon or devil king, but it still catches them by surprise.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
由一名魔法師與三名劍士組成的隊伍來到一座村莊，卻遇上了一場事件。這次與大惡魔或魔王無關，卻依然讓他們措手不及。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
